description_short: The original Bravely Default returns in HD with its acclaimed Brave/Default battle system, more than 20 jobs, modern conveniences and two new mouse-controlled minigames.
description_ar: إعادة إتقان عالية الدقة للجزء الأول من Bravely Default. استخدم نظام Brave وDefault لإدارة BP، وطوّر الشخصيات عبر أكثر من 20 وظيفة، واستكشف Luxendarc مع تحسينات واجهة وجودة حياة وألعاب صغيرة جديدة تستخدم تحكم الفأرة في Joy-Con 2.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
tagline: The story of light and shadow is reborn in high definition.
fitFor: Players who enjoy deep job systems
Players who missed the Nintendo 3DS original

gameplayPillars.title: Brave and Default
gameplayPillars.description: Bank BP by defending with Default or spend future turns early with Brave to create powerful tactical sequences.

gameplayPillars.title: Job System
gameplayPillars.description: Combine more than twenty jobs and support abilities to create highly customized party builds.

gameplayPillars.title: Crystal Quest
gameplayPillars.description: Travel through Luxendarc with Tiz, Agnès, Ringabel and Edea to awaken the elemental crystals.

gameplayPillars.title: Modernized Remaster
gameplayPillars.description: Faster event playback, adjustable encounter settings and improved interface reduce friction from the original 3DS release.

storyChapters.title: The Great Chasm
storyChapters.body: Tiz survives the destruction of Norende and meets the Wind Vestal Agnès.

storyChapters.title: Awaken the Crystals
storyChapters.body: The party crosses Luxendarc to restore the elemental crystals and confront the forces opposing the Crystal Orthodoxy.

storyChapters.title: Light and Shadow
storyChapters.body: Repeated revelations challenge the heroes' understanding of the world, the crystals and the true nature of their journey.

features: High-definition remaster of the first Bravely Default
Classic Brave and Default BP battle system
Retooled networking features for Nintendo Switch 2
perfNotes: Switch 2 runs the HD Remaster at 1920x1080 and a stable 60 FPS in both handheld and docked modes. This is independently reviewed and the developer also confirmed the Switch 2-exclusive remaster was designed around a stable 60 FPS target.

devicePerformance.unavailableReason: Measured resolution/FPS values are not published in the Nintendo store listing.
devicePerformance.performanceNotes: Switch 2 runs the HD Remaster at 1920x1080 and a stable 60 FPS in both handheld and docked modes. This is independently reviewed and the developer also confirmed the Switch 2-exclusive remaster was designed around a stable 60 FPS target.

faq.q: How long is the main story?
faq.a: Game8 estimates roughly 55-60 hours for the main story and 100+ hours to explore all jobs, side scenarios and endings.
The remaster retains the original soundtrack composed by Revo.
HD visuals, redesigned UI, event fast-forward, adjustable encounter behavior, updated networking and two Joy-Con 2 mouse minigames.

faq.q: Does it use the Brave and Default system?
faq.a: Yes. The signature BP-based turn system is preserved.

faq.q: Does the Western Nintendo release list Chinese?
faq.a: Western Nintendo listings commonly list Japanese and major European languages; Chinese availability should be verified against the exact Asian SKU being sold.

verdictSummary: A strong preservation and modernization of a landmark turn-based JRPG, retaining the deep Brave/Default and job systems while adding practical Switch 2 conveniences.
verdictCons: Western Nintendo listing does not include Chinese among supported languages

reviews.quote: The remaster received broadly positive reviews for preserving the battle/job systems while adding useful quality-of-life features.
Critics generally valued the preservation of the original JRPG design and modern convenience features.
The remaster is widely praised for its job system, Revo soundtrack and strategic combat.

patchNotes.body: HD remaster launched with redesigned interface, fast-forward, encounter controls, updated networking and two new mouse-control minigames.
Minor support updates maintained system compatibility and stability.
The remaster remains available on Switch 2 with the original Revo soundtrack intact.
